battle.name: 波蘇戰爭
battle.brief: 波蘇戰爭自一九一九年二月開打，第二波蘭共和國與蘇俄紅軍沿布格河下游、基輔至華沙一線拉鋸。一九二〇年紅軍傾力西進直抵華沙東郊，波蘭軍在維斯瓦河兩岸死守，以法製雷諾FT輕坦克任偵察、掩護與步兵支援，紅軍在城下折戟，六十日內退過納曼河，一九二一年《里加條約》劃定波蘭東界。

kit.name: 雷諾FT輕坦克
kit.history: 1917年已列裝的輕坦克，波蘇戰爭期間配屬波蘭裝甲單位，用於步兵支援與短促機動。

countries: 交戰一方是重建中的波蘭第二共和國。波蘭在一九一八年十一月復國，西部尚要收拾德國殘餘勢力，東部則要同蘇俄支持的紅軍劃定國界。一九一九年春，參謀總長瓦迪斯瓦夫·西科爾斯基統率波蘭軍團自布格河一線反攻；到一九二〇年，東線作戰部隊包括多個步兵師、騎兵旅、砲兵營、混合旅與新生的裝甲部隊，波軍陣中另有以立陶宛與白俄羅斯居民組成的混編第一師。另一方是俄羅斯蘇維埃聯邦社會主義共和國的紅軍：一九一九年由第一、第二集團軍在俄羅斯西部與烏克蘭方向作戰，其後以米哈伊爾·圖哈切夫斯基的第四集團軍與阿列克謝·拉多拉的第十二集團軍分別指向波蘭與里加方向，一九二〇年八月合併為西方戰線，第三集團軍則由亞歷山大·帕爾霍梅科指揮。此外，蘇俄支持烏克蘭人民共和國的蓋爾軍與鄧尼金率領的白軍志願軍在南部戰區活動；紅軍內部尚有共產國際派來的國際支隊、化學防護兵種、鐵道勤務與地方遊擊隊等輔助力量，交戰並不限於雙方正規軍。
countriesEn: One side was the reconstituted Second Polish Republic. Poland had been restored in November 1918, still had to clear German forces out of the west, and in the east had to draw a frontier with the Red Army backed by Soviet Russia. In the spring of 1919 Chief of Staff Władysław Sikorski led the Polish Army Corps in a counter-offensive from the Bug line; by 1920 the eastern front fielded several infantry divisions, cavalry brigades, artillery battalions, mixed brigades and the newly raised armoured units, and the Polish order of battle also included a mixed Lithuanian-Belarusian division recruited from local inhabitants. The other side was the Red Army of the Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic: in 1919 the First and Second Armies fought in western Russia and in Ukraine, and were later followed by the Fourth Army under Mikhail Tukhachevsky and the Twelfth Army under Alexei Radola, which pointed at Poland and at Riga respectively, merging in August 1920 into the Western Front, while Alexander Parkhomenko commanded the Third Army. Soviet Russia also backed the Ukrainian Galician Army of the Ukrainian People's Republic and Denikin's White Army Volunteer formations in the southern theatre, and inside the Red Army there were international detachments sent by the Comintern, chemical protection troops, railway service units and local partisan bands, so the war was not fought by the regular armies alone.
people: 波蘭方面的關鍵人物是國父兼最高統帥約瑟夫·畢蘇斯基，他於一九一九年二月親赴前線督率克爾姆方向的反攻，一九二〇年華沙戰役中仍任最高指揮。參謀總長瓦迪斯瓦夫·西科爾斯基策劃最初的布格河攻勢並主持東線作戰計畫；塔德烏什·羅茲瓦多夫斯基在華沙之役率領主力突擊集團，愛德華·雷茲-希米格指揮莫希奇采一線的反包抄集團，維瓦迪夫·貝利納-普拉日莫夫斯基率騎兵預備隊在華沙市區最危急的一夜衝擊紅軍橋頭堡；維爾納夫·莫拉夫斯基以西歐戰線總指揮身份居中調度，令南北兩個集團軍始終銜接。紅軍一方由米哈伊爾·圖哈切夫斯基出任西方戰線指揮官，策劃一九二〇年八月十四日開始的總攻，阿列克謝·拉多拉與亞歷山大·帕爾霍梅科分掌第十二、第三集團軍，謝苗·布瓊尼的第一騎兵軍在波蘭南部拉鋒；米哈伊爾·弗魯津澤在南線策應，把烏克蘭與白軍戰線壓向波軍側翼。烏克蘭蓋爾軍司令耶夫亨·科諾瓦列茨則是波蘭最重要的盟友，其軍隊一九一九年七月攻入利沃夫，兩國於同年五月訂立軍事同盟。
peopleEn: On the Polish side the key figure was the head of state and commander-in-chief Jozef Pilsudski, who went to the front in February 1919 to direct the counter-offensive around Chelm and remained the supreme commander during the fighting at Warsaw in 1920. Chief of Staff Wladyslaw Sikorski planned the first offensive across the Bug and ran the eastern war effort; Tadeusz Rozwadowski led the main striking group in the battle of Warsaw, while Edward Rydz-Smigly commanded the group that counter-attacked from the south around Moscice, and Wladyslaw Belina-Prazmowski led the cavalry reserve that struck the Red Army bridgehead at the most desperate hour of the night in the city. Verny Morawski, as commander of the Western Front, kept the two Polish groups moving as one. On the Soviet side Mikhail Tukhachevsky took command of the Western Front and planned the general offensive that opened on 14 August 1920, with Alexei Radola and Alexander Parkhomenko holding the Twelfth and Third Armies and Semen Budyonny's First Cavalry Army fighting its way through the south of Poland, while Mikhail Frunze pressed on the southern front to fix the Ukrainian and White forces against the Polish flank. Yevhen Konovalets, commander of the Galician Army, was Poland's most valuable ally: his troops took Lviv in July 1919, and the two states signed a military alliance that May.
kits: 卡面上的雷諾FT輕坦克，是這場戰爭裡波蘭裝甲部隊唯一成建制的地面裝備。FT於一九一七年在法國量產，是史上產量最多的坦克之一：自重約八點四噸，乘員四人，裝備三十七毫米SA 18/37戰砲與一挺同軸機槍，車體前部彈藥艙可容七十二發，最大速度約每小時十四公里，最大行程約二百四十公里，車體與炮塔為鈑金焊接，最厚處不過一至二公分，在當時只擋得住小口徑機槍與步槍彈。波蘭在一九一九至一九二〇年間自法國接收約一百二十輛FT，編入新成立的坦克營與坦克團，並以FT底盤改裝出裝甲汽車與彈藥車。由於總數有限，FT在波蘇戰爭中多司偵察、警戒、掩護步兵與支援砲兵，真正投入縱深突破的次數不多，也很少與敵騎兵正面交鋒。波軍其餘主力是毛瑟步槍、七點九二毫米輕機槍、施瓦羅斯一二式重機槍與七六毫米野戰砲，並有大量軍馬與輜重馬組成的運輸隊。紅軍同樣以步兵密集縱隊配合砲兵與騎兵作戰，輔以裝甲列車與少量裝甲汽車，另設化學防護兵種對付砲火。紅軍在波蘭方向缺乏有效的反坦克砲，坦克多以迂迴、掩體與砲火驅逐，未曾大量被毀。
kitsEn: The Renault FT light tank on the card face was the only organised ground weapon of the Polish armoured forces in this war. The FT entered mass production in France in 1917 and became one of the most widely built tanks ever: it weighed about 8.4 tonnes, carried a crew of four, mounted a 37 mm SA 18/37 gun and a single coaxial machine gun, and its hull magazine held seventy-two rounds. Maximum speed was roughly 14 kilometres per hour and maximum range about 240 kilometres. The hull and turret were welded armour plate no thicker than one or two centimetres, which could stop nothing heavier than small-calibre machine-gun and rifle fire. Poland received about one hundred and twenty FTs from France between 1919 and 1920, forming them into new tank battalions and a tank regiment, and the FT chassis also produced armoured cars and ammunition carriers. Because the total was so small, the FT spent most of the war on reconnaissance, security, shielding infantry and supporting artillery; it was committed to deep penetration only rarely and met the enemy cavalry head-on very seldom. The rest of the Polish strength was Mauser rifles, 7.92 mm light machine guns, Schwarzlose M.07/12 heavy machine guns and 76 mm field guns, with large numbers of horses and draught animals forming the transport columns. The Red Army likewise fought with dense infantry columns supported by artillery and cavalry, aided by armoured trains and a handful of armoured cars, with chemical protection units deployed against artillery fire. The Red Army had no effective anti-tank gun on the Polish front, so tanks were usually driven off by outflanking, cover and massed artillery fire and were rarely destroyed outright.
tactics: 一九一九年的攻勢以河流突破為主：波軍在布格河兩岸選擇數處淺灘，以工兵架橋、步兵密集縱隊在砲火掩護下強渡，再由騎兵偵察找出敵陣弱點插入，紅軍則利用冬季道路與白俄羅斯境內的鐵路網實施反擊與縱深機動。一九二〇年紅軍改採連續戰役式打法，先以第十二、第三集團軍在里加與基輔方向牽制，再由西方戰線集中數萬兵力自維斯瓦河上游強渡，步兵以大縱隊突破，騎兵與裝甲列車跟在後方擴張戰果，試圖在波軍縱深直取華沙。波軍的應對是維斯瓦河沿線的延遲抵抗：不求死守線，而是以少量部隊節節抗擊，把紅軍拖進預設的口袋；一九二〇年八月十三日夜，紅軍突破維斯瓦河並占領華沙東郊的橋頭堡，波軍騎兵預備隊當夜以密集隊形對準橋樑缺口突擊，騎手多數下馬用斧鋸砍斷橋樑，紅軍先鋒因此失去渡河支援。八月十七日後，波軍兩支集團軍自南北對進合圍，紅軍主力被壓回維斯瓦河東岸，騎兵第一軍在科馬羅夫一戰崩潰。此後波軍在九月轉入攻勢，十月沿德維納河直取里加；入冬之後，戰線拉長成數百公里的縱深消耗戰，雙方反覆爭奪橋頭堡與鐵路樞紐。
tacticsEn: The offensive of 1919 turned on river crossings: the Polish army picked shallow fords along the Bug, bridged them with engineer troops, and forded dense infantry columns under artillery cover, while cavalry scouted for weak points in the enemy line and filtered through them; the Red Army answered with counter-attacks and deep manoeuvres along the winter roads and the railway net inside Belarus. In 1920 the Red Army changed to a continuous-operations approach: the Twelfth and Third Armies fixed the Poles in the Riga and Kyiv directions first, then the Western Front concentrated tens of thousands of men and forced the Vistula upstream, infantry breaking through in deep columns with cavalry and armoured trains following to widen the breach, aiming to strike straight at Warsaw in the Polish rear. The Polish answer was a delaying defence along the Vistula: rather than hold the line at all costs, small formations fought delaying actions to drag the Red Army into a prepared pocket. On the night of 13 August 1920 the Reds crossed the Vistula and seized a bridgehead in the eastern suburbs of Warsaw; the Polish cavalry reserve struck at the gap in the bridge at close order that same night, most riders dismounting to cut the structure with axes and saws, so that the Red Army spearhead lost its river crossing support. After 17 August two Polish groups closed in from north and south and encircled the main Red Army body, pressing it back to the east bank of the Vistula, while the First Cavalry Army shattered at Komarow. Poland then went over to the offensive in September, driving up the Daugava in October; with winter came a several-hundred-kilometre war of attrition in which both sides fought repeatedly for bridgeheads and railway junctions.
data: 可核對的數字有限，但大致輪廓清楚。克爾姆攻勢自一九一九年二月十四日打到三月十六日，波軍在該方向投入的兵力以數萬計，紅軍第四集團軍同樣以數萬計，雙方在布格河下游拉出數百公里的戰線。一九二〇年八月，紅軍西方戰線在西線集中火炮以千計，常見說法是數千門以上，另加大量機槍與裝甲列車，是內戰期間規模最大的火力集中之一。波蘭方面的總動員人數超過一百萬，東線野戰部隊在最高峰時有數十萬人；戰事兩年間波軍死亡人數各家統計分歧頗大，概在數萬之數、約五萬上下，受傷者逾十萬。紅軍在波蘭方向的損失同樣以萬計。裝甲方面，波蘭的雷諾FT總數約一百二十輛，編為數個戰術單位；單車自重約八點四噸，乘員四人，砲口三十七毫米，車載彈藥七十二發。戰役中最出名的時間數字是華沙之役：八月十二日紅軍突破維斯瓦河，十三日抵達華沙東郊，十四日波軍反擊，十七日起紅軍總退，至八月二十五日戰役基本結束，六十日內紅軍退回納曼河以東。一九二一年三月十八日《里加條約》簽訂，波蘭取得白俄羅斯西部與烏克蘭西部大片土地，面積以數萬平方公里計、人口以數百萬計，具體數字各方說法不一。
dataEn: The verifiable figures are limited, but the broad outline is clear. The Chelm offensive ran from 14 February to 16 March 1919, with tens of thousands of Polish troops committed in that sector and tens of thousands more of the Red Army's Fourth Army facing them, and the front on the lower Bug stretched for several hundred kilometres. In August 1920 the Red Army's Western Front massed thousands of guns on the western sector, commonly given as several thousand, together with a large number of machine guns and armoured trains, one of the biggest concentrations of fire of the civil war. Poland mobilised more than a million men in total, with hundreds of thousands in field formations on the eastern front at the peak. Polish dead over the two years vary widely between sources, broadly in the tens of thousands and around fifty thousand, with more than a hundred thousand wounded. Red Army losses in the Polish direction were likewise counted in tens of thousands. On the armour side Poland held roughly one hundred and twenty Renault FTs, organised into a small number of tactical units; each vehicle weighed about 8.4 tonnes, carried a crew of four, and had a 37 mm gun and seventy-two rounds carried in the hull. The best known set of dates belongs to the battle of Warsaw: on 12 August the Red Army broke across the Vistula, on the 13th it reached the eastern suburbs of Warsaw, on the 14th the Poles counter-attacked, from the 17th the Red Army fell back in general, and by 25 August the fighting was essentially over, the Reds driven back east of the Narew within sixty days. On 18 March 1921 the Treaty of Riga was signed, handing Poland large parts of western Belarus and western Ukraine, an area counted in tens of thousands of square kilometres with a population in the millions; the exact figures differ from source to source.
cause: 戰爭的根子在一九一七年以後歐洲秩序的崩解。俄國革命後，布爾什維克政權自視為世界革命的策源地，一面在內戰中圍剿白軍，一面企圖把革命向中歐與西歐推進：一九一九年初紅軍第一、第二集團軍曾越過舊有國界，進入立陶宛、白俄羅斯與拉脫維亞，德國共產主義者在內戰末期奪權失敗、匈牙利蘇維埃共和國成立，都讓蘇俄相信革命可以西進。新生的波蘭國家則需要穩住東境：它的經濟仰賴波羅的海港口，東部廣大平原產糧卻握在紅軍與烏克蘭民族主義者手中，協約國劃定的寇松線又未成為現實邊界。波蘭與烏克蘭蓋爾軍在加利西亞的衝突，以及紅軍在烏克蘭與德涅斯特河一線的推進，使雙方終於在一九一九年二月沿布格河正面相撞：波軍試圖以反攻確立寇松線，紅軍則要把戰線推到波蘭境內、鞏固革命成果並取得糧食。紅軍在西線的失利，加上德國局勢的變化，令蘇俄在一九二〇年把重心移回國內戰線，衝突因而延長成兩年零一個月的消耗戰。
causeEn: The roots of the war lay in the collapse of the European order after 1917. After the Russian Revolution the Bolshevik regime regarded itself as the source of world revolution, encircling the White armies in the civil war while trying to push the revolution into central and western Europe: in early 1919 the Red Army's First and Second Armies crossed the old state borders into Lithuania, Belarus and Latvia, and the failure of the German communists to seize power in the last months of the civil war together with the Hungarian Soviet Republic convinced Soviet Russia that revolution could move west. The newborn Polish state, for its part, needed to stabilise its eastern frontier: its economy depended on the Baltic ports, the great eastern plains produced grain but lay in the hands of the Red Army and the Ukrainian nationalists, and the Curzon Line drawn by the Entente had not yet become a real border. The clash between Poland and the Ukrainian Galician Army in Galicia, together with the Red Army's advance along the Dnepper and the Dniester, brought the two sides into open collision on the Bug in February 1919: the Poles tried to establish the Curzon Line by counter-attack, while the Reds meant to push the front into Poland, secure the fruits of the revolution and seize grain. Red Army defeats in the west, combined with changes inside Germany, made Soviet Russia turn its attention back to the internal front in 1920, and the conflict was prolonged into a war of attrition lasting two years and one month.
impact: 這場戰爭同時改變了兩個國家的國運。波蘭方面，一九二〇年華沙之役被寫成維斯瓦河上的奇蹟，成為波蘭民族記憶中最輝煌的一頁，畢蘇斯基的聲望亦隨之蓋過一切；然而戰後軍隊回鄉、軍紀敗壞、總工會罷工與總統選舉的衝突接踵而至，軍人干政於是成為常態，一九二六年的軍事政變由此打開少數人獨裁統治的路，並一路延續到戰前。疆界上，波蘭在東線取得白俄羅斯西部與烏克蘭西部，境內少數民族人口因此膨脹，烏克蘭與白俄羅斯民族主義者在波蘭境內建立武裝組織；這些內部矛盾在二十年後成為東境的伏筆——蘇維埃政權在對岸重建軍力，一九三九年得以循同樣路線進入波蘭東部。紅軍方面，這場敗仗是內戰時期最重的一擊，直接打擊共產黨世界革命的號召力；一九二一年春天克朗施塔特起義爆發，紅軍的疲態暴露無遺，同年夏天被迫以新經濟政策取代戰時共產主義，軍隊本身亦大規模改編。國際上，波蘭的獨立地位由此鞏固，一九二一年與蘇俄建交，但雙方都明白那條停戰線只是暫時的界線。
impactEn: The war changed the course of two states at once. For Poland the battle of Warsaw in 1920 was written up as the miracle on the Vistula and became the brightest page of Polish national memory, carrying Pilsudski's prestige above every other politician; yet the demobilisation, the breakdown of discipline in the army, the general strike and the disputes over the presidential election followed one after another, so that military intervention became the norm, and the coup of 1926 opened the way to rule by a small elite that lasted right up to the war. On the frontier, Poland took western Belarus and western Ukraine, and its minority population swelled accordingly, with Ukrainian and Belarusian nationalists building armed organisations inside Poland; those internal strains became the seed of the eastern crisis two decades later, when the Soviet state rebuilt its armies on the far side of the border and in 1939 was able to enter eastern Poland along the same lines. For the Red Army the defeat was the heaviest blow of the civil war and struck directly at the credibility of world revolution; the Kronstadt rebellion broke out in the spring of 1921, the exhaustion of the Red Army was plain for all to see, and in the summer of that year war communism was abandoned for the New Economic Policy while the army itself was reorganised on a large scale. Internationally Poland's independence was consolidated and diplomatic relations with Soviet Russia were established in 1921, though both sides understood that the armistice line was only a temporary border.
result: 結果是紅軍在西方戰線的大敗與全面退卻。一九二〇年八月下旬起，紅軍被波軍反擊逐出波蘭國土，退回布格河以東；第一騎兵軍在科馬羅夫損失慘重，軍心崩潰，同年九月波軍反過來沿德維納河進軍，十月占領丁格里夫斯克等據點，兵鋒逼近里加，戰線被推入蘇維埃俄羅斯境內。一九二〇年十月十二日，雙方在祖爾科維達成停戰協議；一九二一年三月十八日簽訂《里加條約》，波蘭取得白俄羅斯西部與烏克蘭西部的大片地區，蘇俄承認波蘭的邊界與獨立，兩國恢復外交關係，戰爭至此結束。對波蘭軍隊而言，這是一場代價慘重的勝利：東線部隊在缺糧、缺冬季裝備、缺汽車的條件下作戰，仍在半年內擊退紅軍主力。紅軍在西線的崩潰亦改變了雙方對彼此的估計：紅軍此後再無能力對西發動大規模攻勢，波蘭則在二十年間始終把東境視為不可放棄的方向，國防軍的編制、裝甲部隊與後勤體系都因這場戰爭而重組。而在一九三九年，那條停戰線終究未能守住。
resultEn: The result was a crushing defeat and a general retreat for the Red Army on the Western Front. From late August 1920 the Polish counter-attack drove the Reds out of Polish territory back to the east of the Bug; the First Cavalry Army was devastated at Komarow and its morale broke, and in September the Poles turned the war around, marching up the Daugava, taking Dvinsk and other strongholds in October and driving the front into Soviet Russia as the Polish spearhead closed on Riga. On 12 October 1920 the two sides signed an armistice at Zolkiew, and on 18 March 1921 the Treaty of Riga gave Poland large tracts of western Belarus and western Ukraine, with Soviet Russia recognising Poland's borders and independence; diplomatic relations were resumed and the war came to an end. For the Polish army this was a victory bought at heavy cost: the eastern formations fought short of food, of winter equipment and of motor transport, and still destroyed the main body of the Red Army within half a year. The collapse of the Red Army in the west also changed how each side sized up the other: the Reds were never again able to mount a large-scale offensive towards the west, while Poland treated its eastern frontier as a direction that could not be surrendered for the next twenty years, and the organisation, armoured units and logistic system of the national army were all reorganised in the light of this war. And in 1939 that armistice line could not be held.
